summary: Verified the D1 migration fix for voices-mailbox-migration.sql. All 10 pytest cases pass: endpoint returns 200 with text/plain, header uses regular hyphen (no em-dash), no inline column comments inside CREATE TABLE blocks, exactly the expected 2 tables + 2 indices, no FOREIGN KEY clause, and Python sqlite3.executescript() parses the SQL cleanly and permits sample INSERTs into both tables. Regression on the other 4 migration download endpoints (resources, notary, candles, resources-dv-delta) all still return 200.
critical_code_review_comments: SQL file is clean and D1-compatible (no inline column comments, no FOREIGN KEY, ASCII-only). Fix looks correct.
server.py already has 5+ nearly identical /api/download/*-migration-sql routes - consider refactoring into a single parametrized route or a factory to reduce duplication as more migrations are added.
test_credentials: N/A - endpoints are unauthenticated static file downloads
seed_data_creation: None (in-memory sqlite used for executescript validation, discarded after test)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Migration SQL download endpoints are covered by /app/backend/tests/test_voices_mailbox_migration.py (10 cases). If a new migration file is added, extend REGRESSION_ENDPOINTS list and add a content test similar to TestVoicesMailboxMigration. BASE_URL env var must be exported when running pytest directly (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL).
rca of the issue: Original SQL had inline '-- comments' after each column definition. Cloudflare D1 web console's naive statement splitter mishandles these when combined with newlines/semicolons, causing 'incomplete input: SQLITE_ERROR'. Fix: rewrote SQL with zero inline column comments, removed FOREIGN KEY (D1 doesn't enforce FKs anyway), and replaced em-dash header with plain hyphen. Verified via Python's sqlite3.executescript() which shares SQLite semantics with D1 - parses cleanly and both sample INSERTs succeed.
